title: Laredo shelter waives adoption fees for senior pets all November
excerpt: Laredo Animal Care Services is waiving adoption fees for senior pets for all of November, and every other adoption is just $11 for the month.
content:
Laredo Animal Care Services is waiving adoption fees for senior pets for the entire month of November, giving older dogs and cats at the city shelter a better chance at a home, according to the shelter and the Laredo Morning Times.

The fee waiver honors National Senior Pet Month. All month long, adoptions of any other pet are just $11, the shelter announced.

Every adoption includes spay or neuter surgery. The shelter, at 5202 Maher Ave., is Laredo's only open-admission shelter, taking in stray animals and pets whose owners can no longer care for them.

Senior pets are often the last to be adopted, even though they tend to be calmer and already settled in their personalities. The shelter is asking anyone thinking about adding a pet to the family to consider giving an older animal a home this month.

Sources: Laredo Animal Care Services, Nov. 3, 2026; Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 12, 2026.
